decisions.reason: The client selects blog keywords but does not select or change any blog topics.
The source explicitly labels these as blog keywords and does not change the separate campaign keyword list or its 20-keyword count.
Selecting blog keywords does not alter the required article count, delivery window, inclusion, or publication obligation.
The source provides blog keywords but does not request search-volume data for them or change the existing search-volume requirement.
The blog keyword selection does not change backlink quantity, link-type percentages, or backlink scope.
